The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4f1aab59ba484eb8), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 138-139. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. statement: The set P is connected; denote it by U. On this set dAb = 0, 0 < λ < 1, and λ Richb = Hesshb λ, ∆hb λ = 0, Scalhb = 0. (18.3) Every approach to an interior zero of N has infinite hb-length. Adjoining S gives a complete manifold with smooth one-sided metric hb and lapse λ, with hb|TS = g|TS, λ|S = 0, ∂νhb λ = κ, IIhb = 0, κ = 1 √ 2m . (18.4) 138 The normal νhb points into the base exterior. The attachment is homeomorphic to the original attachment of S, and it is the only finite-distance boundary attachment. Its smooth structure is as follows: (i) If u|S > 0, then N is an original defining function and the base boundary structure replaces N by λ = √ N. The reflected metric is smooth and even, and the signed lapse is smooth and odd. (ii) If u|S = 0, the one-sided base metric and lapse are smooth in the original boundary structure. Their even and odd reflections in base normal distance are at least C2.
